evidence.text: the original at 0x131a8 holds 236 instructions and 919 bytes up to the ret at 0x1353e, so the record keeps the 920-byte extent and sets no function size
the caller race_session_start at 0x128e0 calls this function at 0x128fb as its first step on the race level, so the module names the function race_data_load

the function builds %s\gfx\%s%c.dat from DAT_00007f44, DAT_0011d294, and the letter H or L from DAT_0011d2b8, loads the five lists OSTACLES, TRACK_DATA, OPPONENTS, ANIMATIONS, and CARS_DATA, sets the screen mode 0x140 by 0x190 with the value 0x104, copies the TRACK_DATA color to PTR_DAT_0008a844 + 0x10, and starts the music through 0x2fcec behind DAT_0011d2cc

name: race_data_load
role: builds the race file names, loads the five race lists and the race assets, sets the screen mode and the track color, and starts the race music
